description: The image features a multi-level spiral staircase, rendered with a realistic reflection on a light-colored floor, indicating a polished surface. The staircase is constructed with dark wooden treads, providing warmth and richness, complemented by sleek silver metal balusters that form a graceful, curving railing. The structure extends upwards through what appears to be a light-colored, possibly white, interior space. The uppermost section reveals a small landing area with a window and a protective metal railing, suggesting access to an upper floor or a compact balcony. The overall design emphasizes clean lines and functional elegance, with a prominent 'VONKA' branding visible on the walls.
